[color=#f4cccc]This retexture includes, black, gray, "tan", "red", spotted and white donkeys for you to enjoy in both CP or AT[/color][/font][font=Georgia]

[b][size=4]You will need: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8410][b]Donkeys[/b][/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url]﻿[/size] or [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246][b]Alternative Textures[/b][/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url]﻿. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]GMCM[/b][/url]﻿ is optional but useful for config changes.[/size]

[/b][color=#f4cccc][/color][img]https://imgur.com/MjDDzU6.png[/img]﻿

[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Install Donkeys, Content Patcher/Alternative Textures and SMAPI [/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Install this mod into your mods folder[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Run the game once to generate the config file. You can edit this
manually, but preferably use GMCM to avoid accidentally altering the
files incorrectly; or use AT's scissor tools to change them.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Should uninstall cleanly without issue.[/color][/font][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]

[img]https://imgur.com/FBLwsZn.png[/img]﻿
